minutes.headline: Committee will draft three fall warrant articles and seek a joint meeting with the select board.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee heard the architect contract was finalized and agreed to send high-level layout input rather than fixed placements. It drafted wording for a renovation funding article and an update article, and planned a third for new-construction design funds. It moved to request a joint meeting with the select board and set October meeting dates.

what_happened.line: The committee moved to request a joint meeting with the Board of Selectmen next Tuesday; the vote result was not audible in the recording.
The chair was assigned to draft a third warrant article seeking design funds for new construction and to ask the select board to discuss it.
The committee agreed the funding article would cover the TC Passios renovation per the final report, and the chair would draft a separate update article.
Members agreed to email the architect high-level layout concerns and ask for an outline draft and a target date for first results.
Meetings were set for Sept 22, Oct 13, Oct 20 and Oct 27 at 5:30, hybrid.

why_it_matters: The draft articles would put a renovation appropriation and a possible new-construction design appropriation before voters at a fall town meeting, and either could raise the property tax bill.
The amount in the draft funding article was still to be confirmed, and borrowing terms were not in it, so the tax impact was not yet stated; the financial advisor was to project it.
